# Welcoming Krisan Nichani to Infinite


We are excited to share that Krisan Nichani has joined Infinite as our first hire and Chief Compliance Officer, helping to shape the company and lead our compliance product efforts.


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


November 4, 2025


·


1 min read


Team


We’re thrilled to welcome[Krisan Nichani](https://www.linkedin.com/in/krisan-nichani-00371a20/) as our first hire and Chief Compliance Officer at Infinite!


Krisan is an industry leader at the intersection of fraud prevention, financial crimes, and compliance, and brings a rare blend of practitioner depth and product leadership.


He’s built compliance and risk teams from the ground up at high-growth fintechs, then led product and product strategy at companies like Socure and Sardine. That combination of frontline experience and product thinking aligns perfectly with what we are building here at Infinite.


At Infinite, compliance sits as an embedded layer across our products. Krisan’s expertise reinforces that layer and accelerates our mission to build the next-generation stablecoin rails for global commerce.


Excited to have you on board, Krisan!
